name: Axiom
description: Query your Axiom event data with APL, and read its datasets.
long_description: Axiom's hosted server. It lists datasets and runs APL queries against them, which is the fastest way to get from "something is wrong" to the events that say what.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Axiom in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reads the datasets in the Axiom organisation you sign in to.
